RE-ANCHOR AND VERIFY THE EXTRACTION AT HEAD (DoD 2). NO SOURCE EDITS IN THIS ROW — the parked premise forbids another no-churn reimplementation plan and the reopen scope says VERIFY AT HEAD, DO NOT RE-IMPLEMENT.

(a) Record `git rev-parse HEAD`. The reopenReason anchors 7f0ee691; measured HEAD is 5d214af9 and the branch keeps moving. Re-anchor rather than inheriting.

(b) Confirm the park's premise is void: every owned path is TRACKED and CLEAN. Run `git status --porcelain` on all seven and require it empty, and `git cat-file -e HEAD:<path>` for each. ARCHITECT MEASURED:
    agent-wrapper.ts 390, agent-wrapper-main.ts 360, verifier-process-runner.ts 395,
    process-runner-lifecycle.ts 158 (new, has .js bridge), agent-wrapper-staffing.ts 145 (new, has .js bridge),
    agent-wrapper.test.ts 2013, verifier-process-runner.test.ts 680.

(c) GRADE DoD 2 EXPLICITLY. All three original production files are under 400 (390/360/395, down from the description's 484/417/409) and both new production files are under 250. **The two test files exceed 400 and that is NOT a violation** — the cap is per PRODUCTION file, DoD 2 says 'production files', and a prior governor already ruled a large test-tier file out of scope on task-a9c1fe62. Record this so a grader does not reject on the 2013-line test.

(d) DISCLOSE THE ROSTER DISCREPANCY. The description names SIX owned paths and omits apps/daemon/src/orchestrator/agent-wrapper-staffing.ts, which exists (145 lines, tracked, bridged) and which the governor's own worktree census attributed to this row. Since the extraction has landed there is nothing to edit, so do NOT request a roster expansion — just record the seventh file plainly so QA does not read it as unattributed work.

DoD 1 — THE VERIFY-OR-BLOCK AUTHORITY INVENTORY. The row's real open question, and the one thing a landed extraction can still have got wrong.

Inventory every EXPORT and every BIN call site across the owned set, plus the exact refusal and settlement transitions. Read process-runner-lifecycle.ts (158) and agent-wrapper-staffing.ts (145) against their consumers agent-wrapper.ts (390), agent-wrapper-main.ts (360) and verifier-process-runner.ts (395).

Answer one question in writing: did the landed extraction separate shared mutable lifecycle state WITHOUT widening authority, or did it DUPLICATE that state across modules? Duplicated lifecycle state is the failure mode this DoD exists to catch — two modules each holding their own copy of a cancellation flag or settlement latch behave correctly in tests and diverge under a real race.

For each new module state, name where it lives now, who mutates it, and whether any consumer can now reach a transition it could not reach before the split.

OUTCOME A — separated cleanly with no widened authority: record the inventory as durable evidence (a row comment) and continue.
OUTCOME B — state was duplicated or authority widened: report it and ROUTE IT BACK rather than editing sources to fit a stale DoD. Precedent 3aa6acdb / comment-7625dc5de39b42ec80fae63b131446e8. Do not silently repair a landed extraction inside a verification row.

DoD 5 — THE EXTRACTION MUTATION DRILL, THEN COMPLETE.

(a) NEITHER NEW MODULE HAS ITS OWN TEST FILE (`ls apps/daemon/src/orchestrator/*.test.ts` shows no process-runner-lifecycle.test.ts and no agent-wrapper-staffing.test.ts — both are covered indirectly). So the drill must redden a NAMED assertion inside agent-wrapper.test.ts or verifier-process-runner.test.ts.

Capture exact-path `git status --porcelain` first. All owned paths are TRACKED and CLEAN, so `git diff --exit-code` plus sha256 equality is a valid restore proof.

Mutate the extraction so it BYPASSES the lifecycle/refusal seam — for example, let a consumer drive the underlying process directly instead of through process-runner-lifecycle, or skip the settlement transition. Require the named focused assertion to RED, and quote the failing line. **If the drill comes back GREEN the seam is untested — that is a FINDING to report, not a pass to bank**, and it is the likeliest real defect in a landed extraction that no dedicated test covers. Restore and prove the restore with `git diff --exit-code` plus SHA before finishing.

(b) COMPLETE. Call moe.complete_task ONCE with the step-3(a) gate output as verification {command, exitCode, outputTail}.

**THE COMPLETION COMMIT WILL CARRY NO SOURCE PATHS, AND THAT IS CORRECT.** Every owned path is already tracked and clean at HEAD, so there is nothing left to land. This row was rejected TWICE for 'no completion commit'; a grader applying the ordinary 'commit carries no deliverable = no delivery' tell would reject a third time for a defect that does not exist. State it plainly in completionSummary with the `git cat-file -e HEAD:<path>` evidence for each owned path, and cite the aa205 precedent (completion deb68771 carried zero source paths and was approved DONE).

Do NOT hand-commit — a manual commit fires no post-flight hook and leaves task.commits empty, which is the exact defect rejected twice. Declare the owned paths, exit through the wrapper, and do not verify your own landing before exit; post-flight runs after the session ends.

(c) completionSummary must record: the gate at 4 files / 85 tests and that 85 supersedes the park's stale 81; DoD 2 satisfied with the three production files at 390/360/395 and both new ones at 158/145, plus the note that the 2013- and 680-line TEST files are not cap violations; the DoD 1 inventory outcome; the drill result; and the seventh file (agent-wrapper-staffing.ts) that the description's six-path roster omits. Put overflow in row comments, each under ~4500 chars.

(d) Rail 3: preserve foreign WIP. ~124 paths are dirty tree-wide from live sibling rows — no .moe edits, no blanket staging, no reset, stash, merge or push.
